description: Null the refusal explanation: the refusal-cluster pool constants 'explanation' and 'has_explanation' (adjacent entries, one contiguous 47-byte match) are renamed in place, so the module can no longer read the API's refusal explanation field. Bytecode-only successor of the ?.type==="refusal"?null:null JS patch.

patches.description: Rename the refusal module's 'explanation'/'has_explanation' field constants so the API refusal explanation is never read, stored or displayed

note: Both renames keep their original lengths (11/15); pool length fields remain valid. The length-prefixed 'explanation' form has 7 copies dump-wide, but this exact 47-byte block (incl. the adjacent has_explanation entry) is unique to the refusal cluster (~29363232).
